title: MapPatch OpenStreetMap Intent-to-Edit Compilation
dataset: OpenStreetMap real-changesets augmented before and after diffs
license: ODbL 1.0; preserve attribution and share-alike obligations
blocker: Rejected after the bounded candidate-packet salvage pilot. A metadata-first sample downloaded 6,000 untouched official JSON objects (88,433,089 bytes). The strict 2-6 atom design produced 12 packets and projected 24,631, below the required 30,000; its keyword baseline scored 0.80 and 83.3% of topology/geometry signatures were unique. Relaxing phrase safety projected 55,420 but raised keyword accuracy to 0.859, comment retrieval to 25.9-37.0%, and unique topology signatures to 92.6%. Only 12 strict packets existed, so a valid 300-case blind audit could not be performed. No prepare.py, grade.py, forms, prepared split, or upload ZIP was created.
notes: 2026-08-08 Build-mode audit completed in the exact output folder. Created BLOCKED_BUILD_AUDIT.md, SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md, DATA_ACQUISITION.md, PILOT_GATE_AUDIT.md, NOVELTY_AND_DUPLICATE_AUDIT.md, and README.md.

Official AWS Open Data Registry and real-changesets docs verified source structure: one JSON object per changeset with metadata/elements and old versions for modified/deleted features; license claim ODbL 1.0.

Live S3 checks: listed prefixes 14/15/16 returned objects, prefixes 17/18 returned zero in the quick probe; docs example 142052985.json returned HTTP 404, while listed keys such as 148857621.json and 147186575.json downloaded.

Pilot sample: listed 360 official objects totaling 26,472,703 bytes, downloaded 180 small/medium JSON payloads, and found only 42 generous structural survivors. Reject reasons included element count 88, too many operations 84, bot/import/mechanical markers 82, templated wording 81, incomplete metadata 14, no elements 3, and no comment 1.

Nearest local OSM neighbor is the turn-restriction relation-completion challenge; MapPatch has a distinct target but shares the public OSM lookup surface. The blocker is not duplicate novelty alone; it is answerability plus source-retrieval risk.
